model.contentHashRule: SHA-256 over the zip entries sorted by ordinal name: UTF-8 entry name (as stored, with backslashes) then entry bytes
model.featureScaling: NormalizeMeanVariance, fitted on the 5,000 training records
model.customMapping: EngineeredFeatures; register the RiskClassificationLab assembly with mlContext.ComponentCatalog before loading

decision.score: the Score slot whose slot name is High, read from the loaded model's Score column slot names; never a fixed index
decision.scoreSemantics: SDCA softmax class score in [0, 1]; the three scores sum to 1; not separately calibrated
decision.thresholdSelection: lowest business cost on the winner's 5,000 out-of-fold training scores, flag rate <= 40%; ties keep the higher threshold
decision.otherwise: keep the model's Low or Medium prediction (the default rule) for the three-class label
